import Mathlib

example (A B : Set ℕ) : (A ∪ B)ᶜ = Aᶜ ∩ Bᶜ := by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_inter_iff]
  push Not
  rfl

example (A B : Set ℕ) : (A ∪ B)ᶜ = Aᶜ ∩ Bᶜ := by
  exact Set.compl_union A B
